title: Mother and Baby at Travel Trailer, 1950s B&W Snapshot
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from around the 1950s capturing a mother holding her 12-month-old infant, Sandy, while sitting outside near a travel trailer. On the right side of the frame, dual propane tanks mounted on the trailer's hitch assembly are clearly visible. Handwritten notes on the front margin read 'Sandy & Mommy' at the top and '12 mo. Healing Waters' at the bottom. The image is slightly out of focus.
